instruction.text: Which picture matches the way to stay safe while swimming?

atoms.a: I won’t go swimming if I feel unwell.
When I have problems in the water, I shout for help and wave my arms. I don’t shout for help unless it’s an emergency.
I will let someone responsible know if I am going swimming.
When I swim outside, I will get out of the water immediately if there is lightning, thunder, heavy rain or fog.

instruction.text: Which picture matches the way to stay safe while swimming?

atoms.a: I don’t go into the water when I’m hungry or straight after eating.
I get used to the water temperature before jumping in.
I only go swimming where it is permitted. I only jump into the water where I know it is safe.
I am considerate of others and do not run.
Arm bands, inflatable toys and lilos are not safe and do not protect me from drowning.
I only go swimming if there is someone responsible supervising.

instruction.text: Read the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: On a hot summer day, Luca and his friends cycle to a beach they have never been to before. He gets a big burger and fries from the beach café and sits in the sun to eat. When he has finished eating, he sees his friend Cara is already in the sea. He runs and dives straight in.

b: ++He is swimming straight after a big meal.
++He hasn’t entered the water slowly to get used to the temperature.
++He dived in at a beach he has never been to before.
He is swimming during a thunderstorm.
He is not being considerate to others.

atoms.a: What is one thing Luca should have done before swimming?
b: ++He should have waited to digest his food.
He should have shouted for help as a joke.
He should have blown his nose.

instruction.text: Read the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Isabel is on holiday with her parents. She was feeling unwell this morning, but she really wants to go in the sea. Her parents met friends on the beach and are deep in conversation. Since she doesn’t want to wait any longer, Isabel runs into the water without telling anyone.

b: ++She hasn’t told someone responsible that she is swimming.
She is swimming straight after eating.
She is using an inflatable in the sea.
++She should have waited until tomorrow, when she might feel much better.
She should have eaten a big burger and fries.
